Game Overview

Fruit Collector puts players into a hyper-casual experience centered on catch scrumptious fruits while dodging perilous bombs in this fast-paced arcade delight. Tap left or right to maneuver your basket, racking up high scores by collecting fruits and surviving explosive challenges. Vivid visuals and simple controls blend for an irresistibly thrilling experience. How long can you keep collecting?
